csv_project_name: Consultant for 3900 South; Redwood Rd to Jordan River Bridge
csv_agency: Utah Department of Transportation, Constr Division
csv_scope_of_work: Department Consultant Services staff facilitate Selection Teams through the selection of Consultants to provide engineering services for transportation-related projects. Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT), in cooperation with West Valley City and Taylorsville City, proposes to rehabilitate and reconstruct the existing roadway and implement multimodal improvements along 3900 South/4100 South (Meadowbrook Expressway) between Redwood Road and the Jordan River Bridge. The pavement treatment varies across the corridor, with a 2-inch mill and fill treatment scheduled between Redwood Road and 1300 West, and a full-depth reconstruction planned between 1300 West and the Jordan River Bridge.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
